# Hashing

Ready-made seeded hash and equality callbacks for the key types a hash map or set is keyed on.

<h2 id="hash-uint"><code>HashUint</code></h2>

```rux
pub func HashUint(
    value: uint,
    low: uint64,
    high: uint64
) -> uint64
```

The seeded hash of a `uint`.
`value`, `low` and `high` are read by value. The seed is the table's, and two tables with different seeds hash
the same value differently.
Cannot fail. Runs in constant time and allocates nothing.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Collections/Src/Hashing.rux#L25)

**Parameters**

| Name    | Type     | Description         |
| ------- | -------- | ------------------- |
| `value` | `uint`   | the value to act on |
| `low`   | `uint64` | the first seed word |
| `high`  | `uint64` | the second          |

**Returns**: the value's hash under that seed

<h2 id="hash-slice"><code>HashSlice</code></h2>

```rux
pub func HashSlice(
    text: char8[..],
    low: uint64,
    high: uint64
) -> uint64
```

The seeded hash of a run of characters, which is what a string key comes to.
`text` is borrowed and read. Two slices holding the same characters hash the same however they were built, which
is what makes a text key usable at all.
Runs in time proportional to the length and allocates nothing.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Collections/Src/Hashing.rux#L100)

**Parameters**

| Name   | Type        | Description         |
| ------ | ----------- | ------------------- |
| `text` | `char8[..]` | the bytes to hash   |
| `low`  | `uint64`    | the first seed word |
| `high` | `uint64`    | the second          |

**Returns**: the bytes' hash under that seed

<h2 id="equals-slice"><code>EqualsSlice</code></h2>

```rux
pub func EqualsSlice(
    left: char8[..],
    right: char8[..]
) -> bool
```

Whether two runs of characters hold the same characters.
Both are borrowed and read. Different lengths are never equal, and two empty slices are, whatever their data
pointers hold.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Collections/Src/Hashing.rux#L165)

**Parameters**

| Name    | Type        | Description           |
| ------- | ----------- | --------------------- |
| `left`  | `char8[..]` | one of the two values |
| `right` | `char8[..]` | the other             |

**Returns**: whether both hold the same bytes
